edges.reason: Both occurrences are from the same source (The Guardian) and identify the same three vessels. The NEW quote is a subset of the EXISTING quote.

edges.sentence: On 2026-08-29, The Guardian reported “The “intense” 72-hour operation took place last week, with radars used to monitor four ships that made their way from the North Sea through to the Channel.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “The Royal Navy spent three days tracking Russian vessels as they passed through UK waters, it has emerged.”.

On 2026-08-29, The Guardian reported “The fleet was surveilled by HMS Duncan, HMS St Albans and HMS Severn, with a Merlin helicopter providing support, officials said.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “The fleet was surveilled by HMS Duncan, HMS St Albans and HMS Severn”.
